Who are you? - You live within 30 minutes of Eck en Wiel. - You are a go-getter who likes to take responsibility. - You maintain an overview, work accurately, and find it important that colleagues can count on you.

 - Boxmeer (NL) - Last Mile - 2,700 - 3,500 per month

 Apply directly

You will transport goods under temperature-controlled conditions to and from customers within the Benelux, in accordance with GDP guidelines -

You will keep your vehicle tidy, clean and presentable - 
You are VTS's calling card to our customers Your team

You must be available on weekdays (Monday to Friday) -

Experience with temperature-controlled transport is an advantage - 
You have a strong sense of responsibility and an eye for quality -
